dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: Ha, not a bad place to repair my weapons. Turns out two swords require twice the maintenance.

dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: Weapons are the claws that the Knights of Boreas use to rend the flesh of their enemies, but they are also the hearts that hold our faith.

dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: The weapons of knights of yore often become legends, every bit as well-known as their owners... Tell me, what stories do you think will be told of my blades one day?
